name: askeditor
description:
AskEditor, the video editor.

Aliases: @askeditor, @AskEditor, AskEditor, askeditor.

Use AskEditor when the user tags @askeditor, mentions AskEditor, or asks to edit, cut, trim, caption or subtitle a video, to add music, voice, titles, hooks or motion graphics to one, to make a video from footage or a script, or to open, watch or export an AskEditor project.

Always open the project in the in-app browser beside the chat before the first change, so the user watches every edit as it is made.

Do not satisfy an explicit @askeditor request with another video tool, another editor plugin or a local command unless the user asks for one or approves a fallback.

interface.longDescription: AskEditor is a video editor. This plugin connects your AskEditor account and opens the editor in the in-app browser beside the chat, so you watch every change as it is made: cuts and trims, captions, music and voice, titles, hooks and motion graphics, and the export when you ask for it.
defaultPrompt: Open my latest AskEditor project beside this chat
Add captions to my newest AskEditor video
Make a video in AskEditor from this file
